newsitem.title: USA: CSCE world sugar futures down on spec liquidation.
newsitem.headline: CSCE world sugar futures down on spec liquidation.

text.p: CSCE world sugar futures were sharply lower in brisk dealings on Friday as the speculators began to liquidate high open interest and an extremely heavy net long position, trading sources said.
At 1028 EDT, most-active October was down 0.27 to 11.06 cents, having ranged from 11.32 to 11.00 cents. Spot July stood 0.23 cent lower at 11.14 cents per lb, having ranged from 11.38 to 11.13.
Open interest remains extremely high ahead of the contract's expiry on June 30. As of early Thursday, open interest in July stood at 49,914 lots.
October stood at 86,452 lots, up 4,047 lots.
Early losses triggered sell stops and broke trendlines and moving averages, sending prices to two-week lows, trading sources said.
The October contract 10.96 cents on June 2, when July fell to 11.13 cents.
Support was pegged at 11.00 cents in July, and from 11.00 cents down in most-active October, traders said.
